## Constraints

### Must

- Ship as a single self-contained HTML file, no build step
- Keep gold #C89B3C as the agency accent and copper #B4530A as the academy accent, swapped via [data-arm]
- Pair Fraunces for display with Inter for body, no third family
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion on every animation
- Keep a side gutter of at least 22px and work down to 400px wide
- Use real, verifiable credentials only, never invented statistics or testimonials

### Avoid

- Em dashes in any copy
- Frameworks or bundlers, this site stays dependency free
- Stock-photo filler and decorative imagery without purpose
- Fabricated client logos, quotes or numbers
- More than one primary call to action per section
